endorsements.name: Brian Williams
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-1066
endorsements.description: An issue has been discovered in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 13.3.0 prior to 16.6.7, 16.7 prior to 16.7.5, and 16.8 prior to 16.8.2 which allows an attacker to do a resource exhaustion using GraphQL `vulnerabilitiesCountByDay`
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Brian Williams
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-11340
endorsements.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.3 to 18.3.4, 18.4 to 18.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed authenticated users with read-only API tokens to perform unauthorized write operations on vulnerability records by exploiting incorrectly scoped GraphQL mutations.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.7)
